searchDocs.title: Options​
searchDocs.content: Every option is optional. Pass them in one table: synsaveinstance({ mode = "full" }). Option names are not case-sensitive: NilInstances, nilinstances, and nilInStaNces are the same option. Unknown names are ignored.  Option	Type	Default	Descriptionmode	string	optimized	What to save. optimized saves the most important services (Workspace, Players, Lighting, ReplicatedStorage, StarterGui, and others). full saves everything under game and also turns IgnoreDefaultProperties off, unless you set it yourself. scripts saves only the objects that are, or contain, a [LuaSourceContainer] (a script object), along with the path of parents that lead to them. Objects that don't lead to a script are left out. Any other value saves only ExtraInstances (and Object, if set). If Object is set, optimized becomes full. Binary	boolean	true	Save a binary file (.rbxl/.rbxm) instead of an XML file (.rbxlx/.rbxmx). Binary files are smaller and load faster. If the executor cannot write binary data correctly, the script uses XML. Set the old option XML = true to force XML. CompressionMode	string | boolean	"zstd"	How to compress (make smaller) the binary file: "zstd", "lz4", or false for no compression. true means "zstd". The old option DisableCompression = true means false. CompressionLevel	number	9	Compression level for zstd, from -7 to 22. A higher level makes a smaller file but takes longer. This is ignored for lz4 and when compression is off. FilePath	string | false	false	File name to save to. You can include a folder. If the name has no extension, the script adds one based on Binary and IsModel. If you set this, the script overwrites an existing file and ignores AvoidFileOverwrite. SafeMode	boolean	false	Disconnect the LocalPlayer from the game when saving starts. This turns on KillAllScripts and BoostFPS unless you set them yourself. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. KillAllScripts	boolean	false	Close or disable other running scripts before saving. SafeMode turns this on. Some games stop responding to input after this. That is normal. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. BoostFPS	boolean	false	Turn off 3D rendering while saving, then turn it back on. SafeMode turns this on. Object	Instance | false	false	Save this [Instance] instead of the whole place. The script saves a model if you do not set IsModel = false. If you pass game, it saves the place and uses full mode. You must pass an [Instance], not a name. IsModel	boolean	false	Save a model (.rbxm/.rbxmx) instead of a place (.rbxl/.rbxlx). Object turns this on unless you set it yourself. Passing a list of Instances as an argument also turns it on. ShowStatus	boolean	true	Show a status label on the screen. It shows the size while saving, then the final size and time. ReadMe	boolean	true	Add a README script to the save. It contains save details (place ID, date, time, platform, executor, recovered scripts, warnings) and tips. Decompile	boolean	true	Turn the compiled script back into source code (decompile). This replaces the Source of each [LuaSourceContainer] with decompiled code. If this is off, Source says decompiling is disabled. SaveBytecode	boolean	false	If the executor supports getscriptbytecode, add the compiled script data (bytecode) to Source as a comment. You can decompile it later. This respects DecompileIgnore. DecompileTimeout	number	10	How many seconds one decompile call can take. If it takes longer, the script stops waiting and writes a timeout message in Source. Set to -1 to disable the timeout. DecompileThreads	number	1	How many scripts to decompile at the same time before saving. 1 decompiles one by one while saving. Higher values only help if your executor's decompile yields, and need scriptcache and getscriptbytecode. Decompiler	string	"auto"	Which decompiler turns scripts back into source. "auto" uses the executor's decompile, and uses MoonDecompiler (a LuaU decompiler downloaded from BuiltinDecompilerURL) when the executor has none or it fails. "executor" only uses the executor's decompile. "moon" only uses MoonDecompiler. CustomDecompiler	((script: Instance, bytecode: string?) -> string) | {decompile: (script: Instance, bytecode: string?) -> string} | false	false	Your own decompiler, that can replace the default decompile function with a custom one. BuiltinDecompilerURL	string | false	false	Optional. Where MoonDecompiler is downloaded from when it is needed. Leave it false and the USSI-Redux repository is used automatically (the main branch first, then experimental). BytecodeTimeout	number	3	How many seconds a getscriptbytecode call can take. If it takes longer, the script stops waiting and skips the bytecode for that script. Set to -1 to disable the timeout. DecompileIgnore	{Instance | string} | {[Instance | string]: boolean | {[string]: boolean}}	{TextChatService}	Skip decompiling matched [Instance]s and their children. Source becomes a short ignored message. You can pass an [Instance], a class name, or ClassName = {Name1, Name2}. Set an [Instance] to false to skip only that instance, not its children. SourceCache	{[Instance]: string} | false	false	Source text to use for these scripts as-is instead of decompiling them. DecompileJobless	boolean	false	Only use scripts that are already in the decompile cache. Missing scripts get a short not-found message. This turns on scriptcache. SkipCrashedScripts	boolean	true	Remember which script was being decompiled. If the executor crashed or the game closed mid-decompile, the next run skips that script (its Source says so) instead of crashing again, so rerunning the save gets past the crash point. The list is kept in EXEC_STATE.json. RetryCrashedScripts	boolean	false	Forget the scripts remembered by SkipCrashedScripts and try to decompile them again. Use this if a script was skipped by mistake, for example when you closed the game during a save. scriptcache	boolean	true	If the executor supports getscriptbytecode, cache decompiled code. This avoids decompiling the same script twice. The cache stays after the script reloads. RecoverScriptsFromAssets	boolean	true	Recover the original Source of scripts that were published as assets. Changes made after publishing are not included. IsolatePlayers	boolean	false	Put every [Player] under a top-level "Players" Folder instead of inside the [Players] service. This turns on SaveNotCreatable. If both are on, this option is used instead of IsolateLocalPlayer. IsolateLocalPlayer	boolean	false	Save the LocalPlayer as a Folder named "LocalPlayer" instead of a [Player] object. This is ignored if IsolatePlayers is on. IsolateLocalPlayerCharacter	boolean	false	Save LocalPlayer.Character as a [Model] named "LocalPlayer Character". This saves the character even when characters are normally skipped. IsolateStarterPlayer	boolean	false	Put [StarterPlayer]'s children under a top-level "StarterPlayer" Folder. The original service stays, but it is empty. SavePlayerCharacters	boolean	false	Save player characters instead of skipping them. This also saves objects with Archivable = false, so IgnoreNotArchivable is forced on. NilInstances	boolean	false	Include objects that have no parent (they are not under game). This needs the executor function getnilinstances. When that function exists, it also turns on SaveNotCreatable. ExtraInstances	{Instance}	{}	A list of [Instance]s to add to the normal save. If mode is not a valid value, only these Instances (and Object, if set) are saved. Passing a list of Instances as an argument fills this list. IgnoreList	{Instance | string} | {[Instance | string]: boolean | {[string]: boolean}}	{CoreGui, CorePackages, Packages = false}	Objects to skip. Use an [Instance] or a class name as a key to skip that object and its children. ClassName = false keeps the object but skips its children. ClassName = {Name1, Name2} skips objects with those names. You can also pass a list of Instances or class names. MaxDepth	number	1000	Objects nested deeper than this are moved up under their ancestor at depth MaxDepth, so nothing is dropped, only the nesting is lost. This stops very deep hierarchies from overflowing the stack when Roblox Studio opens the file (binary saves opened at 1740 levels deep; XML saves crashed at 1750). Use math.huge to disable. IgnoreSpecialProperties	boolean	false	Do not use the executor function gethiddenproperty. Other property reads still work. This can help if your executor crashes or the file is corrupted. AlternativeWritefile	boolean	true	Write the file in smaller pieces with appendfile instead of one writefile call. For binary saves, if appendfile fails, it uses writefile; if both fail, it switches to XML. Anonymous	boolean | {Name: string?, UserId: number?}	false	RISKY: Replace LocalPlayer.Name and UserId in the output. true replaces them with "Roblox" and 1. You can also pass a table with Name and/or UserId. Name matching ignores case. This can also change other text or numbers that match. RiskyServicesDisabled	{UGC: boolean?, Encoding: boolean?, Reflection: boolean?}	{UGC = true, Encoding = false, Reflection = false}	Turn off services that some games may detect. UGC skips [UGCValidationService] (used for some hidden properties). Encoding skips [EncodingService]. Reflection skips [ReflectionService] (used for class data). Set a flag to true to skip that service. If you do not set RiskyServicesDisabled yourself, the UGC fallback turns on automatically when gethiddenproperty is missing. AvoidFileOverwrite	boolean	true	If FilePath is not set, add (1), (2), ... to the file name instead of overwriting an existing file. AntiIdle	boolean	true	Stop Roblox from kicking you for being idle (not moving) for 20 minutes. CopyToClipboard	boolean	false	Copy the result to the clipboard (the copy/paste buffer) instead of writing a file. Your executor must support setrbxclipboard. Use this only for small saves. Callback	((data: string, chunks: {string}) -> ()) | false	false	Call this function with the result instead of writing a file. It receives the full text and a list of chunks. If CopyToClipboard is also on, the clipboard is used instead. IgnoreProperties	{string}	{}	A list of property names to skip on every object. For example: {"Tags", "AttributesSerialize"}. IgnoreNotArchivable	boolean	true	Save objects even when their Archivable property is false. If this is off, the script skips those objects. SaveNotCreatable	boolean	false	Save classes that Roblox says are not creatable. The script replaces them with a class it can create, using NotCreatableFixes (usually Folder). This turns on automatically with IsolatePlayers, IsolateLocalPlayer, and NilInstances (when getnilinstances exists). NotCreatableFixes	{string} | {[string]: string | false}	built-in replacements	Replace a class with a class that can be created. The default replacement is "Folder". A list of class names also becomes Folder. Built-in changes: [Player], [PlayerGui], [PlayerScripts], [TouchTransmitter], and others become Folder; [CloudLocalizationTable] becomes [LocalizationTable]; Platform becomes [Part]; Status becomes [Model]. Set a class to false to skip its replacement. NilInstancesFixes	{[string]: ((instance: Instance, overrides: table) -> Instance?) | false}	built-in Animator/AdPortal/Attachment/BaseWrap/PackageLink fixes	Where to put objects that have no parent. For example, it puts [Animator] under an [AnimationController]. Built-in fixes exist for [Animator], [AdPortal], [Attachment], [BaseWrap], [PackageLink], [DebuggerWatch], and [PluginAction] (the last two have no valid parent, so they are skipped). Child classes use the parent fix ([Bone]s use the Attachment fix). Set a class to false to turn off its fix. IgnoreDefaultProperties	boolean	true	Skip properties that already have the default value for their class. This only affects XML output. Binary output does not use this option. IgnorePropertiesOfNotScriptsOnScriptsMode	boolean	false	Only in scripts mode: save properties for [LuaSourceContainer]s and skip properties for all other objects. This does nothing in other modes. IgnoreDefaultPlayerScripts	boolean	false	Skip Roblox's default player scripts (PlayerModule, BubbleChat, ChatScript, PlayerScriptsLoader, RbxCharacterSounds). This can stop some executors from crashing during decompile. SaveCacheInterval	number	0x1600 * 10	How much XML data the script holds in memory while saving. Lower values update the status more often but are slower. This does not write to disk. When KillAllScripts is on, this also sets the script timeout between 20 and 30 seconds. SharedBinaryStrings	boolean	false	Store the same binary data (meshes, images, ...) only once in the file. This makes saves with repeated data smaller. Files with all unique data can get slightly bigger. This is not an official Roblox format, but Studio can still open the file. TreatUnionsAsParts	boolean	false	Change all [PartOperation]s (unions and intersections) into [Part]s. RISKY: you lose the merged shape, but executors that cannot read unions will still show visible parts. ShutdownWhenDone	boolean	false	Close the game after a successful save. __DEBUG_MODE	boolean | ((...any) -> ())	false	Print debug warnings for unusual cases. If you pass a function, the script uses it instead of warn.

searchDocs.title: Load it​
searchDocs.content: local Params = { RepoURL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewexec/USSI-Redux/main/", SSI = "saveinstance", } local synsaveinstance = loadstring(game:HttpGet(Params.RepoURL .. Params.SSI .. ".luau", true), Params.SSI)() synsaveinstance({}) -- saves with the default options   Pass a table of options to change what is saved and how:  synsaveinstance({ mode = "full", SafeMode = true, DecompileTimeout = 15, })   Option names are not case-sensitive, and many have aliases. Every option is listed on the API Reference page, and the generated type page documents the SaveInstanceOptions type.

searchDocs.title: Output​
searchDocs.content: By default the save is a binary place file (.rbxl, or .rbxm for a model). It is much smaller and faster to load than XML. Set XML = true for .rbxlx / .rbxmx.  Option	Default	MeaningBinary	true	Save as binary instead of XML. CompressionMode	"zstd"	How binary chunks are compressed: "zstd", "lz4" or false for none. CompressionLevel	9	Compression strength from -7 to 22. Higher is smaller but slower. Callback	false	Send the data to a function instead of writing a file. CopyToClipboard	false	Put the output on the clipboard. Only suits small saves. MaxDepth	1000	Objects nested deeper than this are moved up under their ancestor at that depth, so nothing is dropped. This stops very deep hierarchies from overflowing the stack when Roblox Studio opens the file.

searchDocs.title: Modes​
searchDocs.content: mode chooses what gets saved.  Mode	What it saves"optimized" (default)	The most important services: Workspace, Players, Lighting, ReplicatedStorage, StarterGui and others. "full"	Everything under game. It also sets IgnoreDefaultProperties to false, unless you set that option yourself. "scripts"	Only the objects that are, or contain, a script, plus the parents that lead to them. any other value	Only ExtraInstances (and Object, if set).  If you set Object, "optimized" becomes "full". Saving game as the Object is the same as "full".  IgnoreDefaultProperties only affects XML output. Binary saves do not use it.  -- keep every property, even defaults synsaveinstance({ mode = "full" }) -- "full" mode, but still skip default values synsaveinstance({ mode = "full", IgnoreDefaultProperties = true })

searchDocs.title: Decompiling scripts​
searchDocs.content: Scripts are decompiled automatically. saveinstance uses your executor's decompile, and falls back to MoonDecompiler, a decompiler written in Luau that is downloaded from this repository the first time it is needed. The fallback is used when the executor has no decompile, it errors, or it returns nothing.  Option	Default	MeaningDecompile	true	Turn decompiling on or off. Decompiler	"auto"	"auto", "executor" (only the executor's decompiler) or "moon" (only MoonDecompiler). CustomDecompiler	false	Your own decompiler: a function (script, bytecode) -> string, or a table with a decompile method. It is tried first. DecompileTimeout	10	Seconds one decompile call may take. -1 disables the timeout. DecompileThreads	1	How many scripts to decompile at once. Only helps if your executor's decompile yields. scriptcache	true	Reuse decompiled output for identical scripts. SaveBytecode	false	Add each script's bytecode to its Source as a comment.  synsaveinstance({ CustomDecompiler = function(script, bytecode) return decompileWithMedal(bytecode) -- return the source text end, })   Functions MoonDecompiler can't rebuild with normal structure are saved as a loop over a program counter, or as a commented disassembly, and start with a comment saying why.

searchDocs.title: Recovering from a crash​
searchDocs.content: Some executors crash on particular scripts during decompile. USSI Redux remembers which script was being decompiled, so you can simply run the save again.  Before each decompile, the script is recorded in EXEC_STATE.json. The record is removed when the decompile finishes.If the executor crashes, the record is still there on the next run. That script is marked as crashed.The next run skips it. Its Source says it crashed the executor on a previous run, and the rest of the save carries on.  Option	Default	MeaningSkipCrashedScripts	true	Turn this protection on or off. It needs writefile. RetryCrashedScripts	false	Forget the remembered scripts and try them again.  Closing the game in the middle of a decompile looks the same as a crash, so that script is skipped on the next run. If a script was skipped by mistake, run once with RetryCrashedScripts = true.  The same state file remembers which gethiddenproperty types crashed or failed on your executor, so those types are skipped on later runs.

searchDocs.title: Staying safe​
searchDocs.content: Option	Default	MeaningSafeMode	false	Kicks you before saving, which keeps you safe. Highly recommended. KillAllScripts	false	Kills all scripts to protect you further. SafeMode also turns it on. BoostFPS	false	Turns off 3D rendering while saving. SafeMode also turns it on. Anonymous	false	Risky. Removes your name and user ID from the file. IgnoreSpecialProperties	false	Don't use gethiddenproperty. Helps if your executor crashes or the file is corrupted.  saveinstance does not modify game state, which helps keep it stable and compatible.

searchDocs.title: Using the options type​
searchDocs.content: saveinstance.luau is written for Luau's --!strict mode and exports a SaveInstanceOptions type. If you type-check your own scripts, you can use it to get autocomplete and errors for misspelled options:  local options: SaveInstanceOptions = { mode = "full", DecompileTimeout = 15, }

searchDocs.title: Where to go next​
searchDocs.content: The API Reference lists every option with its type, default and description.The type page documents the SaveInstanceOptions type and the synsaveinstance function.The source on GitHub has the code, TODO.md and the decompiler.This project is based on luau's UniversalSynSaveInstance and the Roblox file format specifications. See the README for the full list of credits.

Default: false BytecodeTimeout: number-- How many seconds a getscriptbytecode call can take. If it takes longer, the script stops waiting and skips the bytecode for that script. Source becomes a short ignored message. You can pass an Instance, a class name, or ClassName = {Name1, Name2}. Set an Instance to false to skip only that instance, not its children. Use an Instance or a class name as a key to skip that object and its children. ClassName = false keeps the object but skips its children. ClassName = {Name1, Name2} skips objects with those names. Default: true AntiIdle: boolean-- Stop Roblox from kicking you for being idle (not moving) for 20 minutes. Default: true CopyToClipboard: boolean-- Copy the result to the clipboard (the copy/paste buffer) instead of writing a file. Your executor must support setrbxclipboard. Use this only for small saves. Default: false Callback: (( data: string, chunks: {string} ) → ()) | false-- Call this function with the result instead of writing a file. It receives the full text and a list of chunks. If CopyToClipboard is also on, the clipboard is used instead. Default: false IgnoreProperties: {string}-- A list of property names to skip on every object. For example: {"Tags", "AttributesSerialize"}. Default: {} IgnoreNotArchivable: boolean-- Save objects even when their Archivable property is false. If this is off, the script skips those objects. Default: true SaveNotCreatable: boolean-- Save classes that Roblox says are not creatable. The script replaces them with a class it can create, using NotCreatableFixes (usually Folder). This turns on automatically with IsolatePlayers, IsolateLocalPlayer, and NilInstances (when getnilinstances exists). Default: false NotCreatableFixes: {string} | {[string]: string | false}-- Replace a class with a class that can be created. The default replacement is "Folder". A list of class names also becomes Folder. Built-in changes: Player, PlayerGui, PlayerScripts, TouchTransmitter, and others become Folder; CloudLocalizationTable becomes LocalizationTable; Platform becomes Part; Status becomes Model. Set a class to false to skip its replacement. Default: built-in replacements NilInstancesFixes: {[string]: (( instance: Instance , overrides: table ) → Instance? ) | false}-- Where to put objects that have no parent. For example, it puts Animator under an AnimationController. Built-in fixes exist for Animator, AdPortal, Attachment, BaseWrap, PackageLink, DebuggerWatch, and PluginAction (the last two have no valid parent, so they are skipped). Child classes use the parent fix (Bones use the Attachment fix). Set a class to false to turn off its fix. Default: built-in Animator/AdPortal/Attachment/BaseWrap/PackageLink fixes IgnoreDefaultProperties: boolean-- Skip properties that already have the default value for their class. This only affects XML output. Binary output does not use this option. Default: true IgnorePropertiesOfNotScriptsOnScriptsMode: boolean-- Only in scripts mode: save properties for LuaSourceContainers and skip properties for all other objects. This does nothing in other modes. Default: false IgnoreDefaultPlayerScripts: boolean-- Skip Roblox's default player scripts (PlayerModule, BubbleChat, ChatScript, PlayerScriptsLoader, RbxCharacterSounds). This can stop some executors from crashing during decompile. Default: false SaveCacheInterval: number-- How much XML data the script holds in memory while saving. Lower values update the status more often but are slower. This does not write to disk. When KillAllScripts is on, this also sets the script timeout between 20 and 30 seconds. Default: 0x1600 * 10 SharedBinaryStrings: boolean-- Store the same binary data (meshes, images, ...) only once in the file. This makes saves with repeated data smaller. Files with all unique data can get slightly bigger. This is not an official Roblox format, but Studio can still open the file. Default: false TreatUnionsAsParts: boolean-- Change all PartOperations (unions and intersections) into Parts. RISKY: you lose the merged shape, but executors that cannot read unions will still show visible parts. Default: false ShutdownWhenDone: boolean-- Close the game after a successful save. Default: false __DEBUG_MODE: boolean | ((...any) → ())-- Print debug warnings for unusual cases. If you pass a function, the script uses it instead of warn. Default: false } Options for UniversalSynSaveInstance.synsaveinstance. All fields are optional. The default is shown at the end of each field. Option names are not case-sensitive: NilInstances, nilinstances, and nilInStaNces are the same option. Unknown names are ignored.

searchDocs.content: </> interface OptionsAliasesInverse { DisableCompression: string-- CompressionMode NoDecompile: string-- Decompile noscripts: string-- Decompile NullifyScripts: string-- Decompile Overwrite: string-- AvoidFileOverwrite RemovePlayerCharacters: string-- SavePlayerCharacters RemovePlayers: string-- IsolatePlayers SkipScripts: string-- Decompile XML: string-- Binary } Map of old option names that change a true/false value to the opposite. Format: { OldName = NewName } The script flips the value before it uses it. noscripts = true sets Decompile = false. DisableCompression = true sets CompressionMode = false. Overwrite = true sets AvoidFileOverwrite = false. The script reads these before your options, so you cannot change them after the script starts.

searchDocs.title: synsaveinstance​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> UniversalSynSaveInstance.synsaveinstance( ...: table | SaveInstanceOptions | Instance | string-- UniversalSynSaveInstance.SaveInstanceOptions tables are combined in order. An executor's native SaveInstanceOptions object is read the same way as a table, but not every property may be supported, because the property set varies per executor. An Instance becomes Object. A string becomes FilePath; an empty string counts as not set. A list of Instances becomes ExtraInstances and sets IsModel = true. If you pass Instances directly and do not set mode, mode becomes invalid, so only those Instances are saved. ) → string?-- The output file path when saving to a file, or nil when Callback or CopyToClipboard is used. Save the current place, one Instance, or a group of Instances. Example: local Params = { RepoURL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewexec/USSI-Redux/main/", SSI = "saveinstance", } local synsaveinstance = loadstring(game:HttpGet(Params.RepoURL .. Params.SSI .. ".luau", true), Params.SSI)() local SaveInstanceOptions = { SafeMode = true, DecompileTimeout = 15, SaveBytecode = true } synsaveinstance(SaveInstanceOptions) You can pass any number of arguments, in any order: synsaveinstance({ mode = "scripts" }, "myScripts.rbxlx") synsaveinstance(workspace.Model) -- Object; saved as a model synsaveinstance({ workspace.Model, workspace.OtherModel }) -- ExtraInstances
